scenarios.scenario: Toggle between tabs-only and full Sketch ribbon display

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in the MCAD Software
a part with an editable sketch is active in the MCAD Software
Minimize to Tabs is the selected ribbon display mode
the full Sketch command groups are visible
the user activates the ribbon display control
the command groups disappear and the ribbon tabs remain visible
the sketch remains in edit mode
the user activates the ribbon display control again
the full Sketch command groups are visible
the sketch remains in edit mode
the user activates the ribbon display control again
the command groups disappear and the ribbon tabs remain visible
the user activates the ribbon display control again
the full Sketch command groups are visible
the sketch remains in edit mode

scenarios.scenario: Cycle all ribbon display modes in one part session

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is open in the MCAD Software
the ribbon display control is configured to cycle through all modes
the View ribbon tab displays its full groups of commands
the user activates the ribbon display control
the View groups are shown as compact buttons
the user activates the ribbon display control again
the View group titles appear in a narrow strip
the user activates the ribbon display control again
the tabs remain visible without a permanent group strip
the user selects the View tab
its commands appear in a temporary panel
the user activates the ribbon display control again
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport
the full View command groups remain visible
the same part remains active

scenarios.scenario: View additional Options commands from a compact panel button

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is open in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon displays compact panel buttons
the user clicks the Options panel button
a temporary Options panel opens below the ribbon
it shows Application Options, Document Settings and Customize
it also shows Reset UI Layout
the user clicks empty viewport space outside the panel
the temporary Options panel closes
the compact Tools panel buttons remain visible

scenarios.scenario: Keep a temporary ribbon open when repeating its tab click

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools tab is selected in tabs-only ribbon display
the user clicks the Tools tab
the Tools command groups appear temporarily below the tabs
the user clicks the Tools tab again
the temporary Tools command groups remain visible
the user presses Escape
the temporary Tools command groups remain visible
the user clicks empty viewport space
the temporary command groups close
the Tools tab remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Double-click an inactive ribbon tab before cycling its display

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the ribbon display control is set to cycle through all modes
the user double-clicks the inactive Tools tab
Tools becomes the active tab
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the user double-clicks the active Tools tab
the Tools ribbon displays panel buttons
the user double-clicks the active Tools tab three more times
the full Tools ribbon is visible again

scenarios.scenario: Double-click an inactive tab in tabs-only display

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon display control is set to cycle through all modes
Tools is the active tab in tabs-only ribbon display
the user double-clicks the inactive View tab
View becomes the active tab
its command groups appear in a temporary panel
the user clicks empty viewport space
the temporary command groups close
View remains the active tab in tabs-only display
the user double-clicks the active View tab
the full View command groups are visible

scenarios.scenario: Switch tabs while temporary commands are open in tabs-only mode

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is in tabs-only display with View active
the temporary View command groups are open
the user clicks the Tools tab
Tools becomes the active tab
the temporary Tools command groups replace the View command groups
the user clicks empty viewport space
the temporary Tools command groups close
Tools remains the active tab in tabs-only display
